UFO .REPORCI' RECEIVED OVER TELEPHOOE FROM GREATER PITTSBURGH, AIRPORT, 18 Apr 66


Sheriff Spaur, Ravenna, Ohio, spotted object 0300-0600, 17 Apr 66.                 First sighted
in Ravenna along Route 224 and 44, followed object to Conway for about 80 miles.
Object seemed t o take off from ground, oblong, shaped with antenna projecting from
                                                           •                                                   •
                                                                                    •
it.     There we ~5 no colored lights only a very bright silvery · radiance, object
flying 500 fe:e t over vehicle.         It would slow down and speed up and then go very
fast.     The glow was so bright it blinded the driver of the vehicle.              Object going
due East.     Wi t nessed by people from Ravenna and Conway.        Three more from Sheriff's
office.     Two cars followed object along this route.          Dep Sheriff Dale F. Spaur,
was observer.     Pittsburgh didn't send up agy aircraft.          Have flying box cars 119,
is all they have.            Air National G~ard was contacted to scramble their 102's but
they didn' t since nothing showed up on radar.           The 102's were not scrambled.
They belong t 0 t he Air National         c~ard.   The release on the sighting was broke from
the Sherif f' s office at East Palestine, Ohio and Conway, Pa.           He has tried to contact
                                                                                                               •

      Photo Analysis, of the negative submitted by Chief of Police Gerald F.
Buchert, Mantua , Ohio, indicPtes that the "very bright light" which he tried to
                                                                                            •
                                                                                                            .•
                                                                                                                         •
photograph does not appear as an image.            The two images which appear on the
negetive are probably the result of processing defects due to old fogged fi£m
and poor handling.        If the object was "bright" against a dark sky the images
                                                                                                                         •
should be plus density, however, they were not.               The average background density                         •                   •


was 1.25, the image density was 1.06.

      The probable cause of the sighting by Deputy Sheriff Spaur of Ravenna, Ohio
was the pass~ge of a satellit e over northeastern Ohio.                   As the satellite approached
                                                                                                                                 \
the southeas~ portion of the s£7, the satellite disappeared and Deputy Sheriff
                                                                                                                                 I
Dale F. Spau= focused his eyes on the planet Venus.                  Venus was rising in the
southeast s n~ was at a magnitude of -3.9 which would be brighter than other stars
                                                                                                                                 I
                                                                                                                                 I


in the sky.         It is believed that Deputy Sheriff Spaur was chasing the planet
                                                                                                                                 I
Venus.       Rad~    indicates that no airborne objects were in the area of the sighting
                                                                                                                                 I
during the period that Deputy Sheriff Spaur was chasing the UFO.
